deesc_admit_ignorance: I beg your pardon, but I know nothing whatever of that.
You must forgive me -- it is a thing I have never heard of.
I am ignorant of it altogether, and will not pretend otherwise.
That is quite beyond my knowledge, I am sorry to say.
I have no acquaintance with such a thing at all.
I cannot help you there; it is outside anything I know.
